sensitivity.title: Sensitivity
sensitivity.description: Higher finds subtler cuts: the threshold is three times higher at 0 and three times lower at 1 than at 50 %.

min_scene_ms.title: Shortest shot
min_scene_ms.description: A cut closer than this to one already reported is not reported.

black_level.title: Black level
black_level.description: A frame whose mean brightness is under this is black.

min_black_ms.title: Shortest black
min_black_ms.description: Black stretches shorter than this are not reported.

outputs.name: cuts
outputs.label: Cuts
outputs.description: The first frame of each new shot, as an instant, scored from 0 for a change just past the threshold toward 1 for a change far past it.

outputs.name: black
outputs.label: Black
outputs.description: Stretches where the picture stays black, scored from 0 at the black level to 1 for pure black.
